sourceLabel: 定性研究报告基础（COREQ / SRQR）
description: 适用于访谈、焦点小组及其他定性研究；提示方法、反身性、分析路径和伦理说明。
descriptionEn: For interviews, focus groups, and other qualitative studies; flags methods, reflexivity, analytic path, and ethics reporting.

rules.message: 定性研究需要可识别的方法章节。
rules.messageEn: Qualitative research needs an identifiable Methods section.

rules.message: 请确认伦理审批、参与者同意和隐私保护已经说明。
rules.messageEn: Confirm that ethics approval, participant consent, and privacy protection are reported.

rules.message: 请说明研究者角色、反身性、抽样、数据收集和分析路径。
rules.messageEn: Report researcher role, reflexivity, sampling, data collection, and analytic path.

rules.message: 请根据研究方法选择并核对 COREQ 或 SRQR 官方清单。
rules.messageEn: Select and check the official COREQ or SRQR checklist according to the study method.
